summary.headline: Astrological Codex Contents
summary.text: Table of contents for excerpts from Codices 15, 18, 19, 20, 24, and 31, listing Theophilus on planetary animals and plants; Apomasar, Harranian cosmic-year theory, Dog Star omens, lecanomancy, Heliodorus, Zanates, Valens, Protagoras, Julian of Laodicea, Antiochus, and Peter the philosopher; and works on zodiacal signs, decans, planetary conjunctions, seismology, and thunder-books, followed by addenda, corrigenda, and indices.
